# Dmytro's Blog

> Computer vision, image matching, deep learning and academic life — notes by Dmytro Mishkin, PhD.

Written by Dmytro Mishkin, PhD — computer vision researcher and consultant,
maintainer of the Kornia library. Full CV, publications and talks: https://dmytro.ai

- [How ChatGPT fared in computer vision course homeworks at CTU in Prague](https://blog.dmytro.ai/posts/2025-09-17-chatGPT-as-a-student.html): Better than average human?
- [How I cope with the flood of arXiv papers](https://blog.dmytro.ai/posts/2021-02-18-how-i-read-arxiv.html): hope, that it could help you as well
